title: HAAY HUSSAIN PYAASE HUSSAIN
body:
Jaane Payambar Dilbare Zehra
Apna Bhara Ghar Tu ne lutaya
Ibne Ali Ehsaan Hai Tera
Tu Hai Muhaafiz Kaaba e Haq Ka
Sajde Me Sar Tera Kata
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Pyaase Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Dhoond rahe hain rann me Sarwar
Bechaini se Laasha-e Akbar
Khaate hain har gaam pa thokar
Kaun sahara dega badhkar
Aalam e Ghurbat Dashte Bala
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Pyaase Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ki Aankhon ke Ujaale
Aun o Mohd rann ko sidhaare
Jang huwi aur khoo'n me nahaaye
Maqtal se jab aaye Laashe
Karti hai Zainab Shukre Khuda
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Pyaase Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Byaah huwi kuchh der na guzri
Rann ko chali Qasim ki sawaari
Kubra baithi sonch rahi thi
Ab ujdegi maang Hamari
Aagaya Dulha ka Laasha
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Pyaase Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Thaame kamar ye kehte the Sarwar
Dashte bala me Shaane kata kar
Qatl huwe Abbase Dilawar
De pursa Mujhko Meri Khwahar
Hogaya Zainab me tanha
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Pyaase Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Bain yehi karti thi Sakina
Chhor gaye kyun Mujhko tanha
Badhta hai jangal ka andhera
Aajaao Aajaao Baba
Deti hu'n kab se Tum ko sada
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Pyaase Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Soti thi seene pa Tumhaare
Tum ne MereNaaz Uthaaye
Shimr ne maare Mujh ko tamaache
Khoon tapakta hai kaano'n se
Neend nahi'n aati Baba
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Pyaase Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaisi ghadi hai Aale Nabi par
Ghash me pade hain Abid-e Muztar
Keh de koi Abbas se jaakar
Chheen raha hai Shimr-e Sitamgar
Binte Ali ke Sar se Rida
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Pyaase Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ke Baazu me rasan hai
Aur labo'n par bas ye sukhan hai
LaashTeri be goro kafan hai
Aaj bahut majboor Bahan hai
Sar pa nahi'n chaadar Bhayya
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Pyaase Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Ham pa ye ehsaan hai Zainab ka
Jis ne diya Majlis ka saleeqa
Karte raho Maatam Pyaaso'n ka
Denge Tumhe Abbas sahara
Binte Payambar dengi Dua
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Pyaase Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Chhalke kuch itne aankhon ke saaghar
Phaili kuch itni ashkon ki chaadar
Chashme Falak hairan hai is par
Soch rahe hain saare Samandar
Kitne hain aakhir Ashk e Aza
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Pyaase Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Zeest ka magsadPyaaso'n ka Gham
Hota rahe ta Hashr ye Maatam
Leke yu'nhi Abbas ka Parcham
Parwaane Shabbir ke har dam
Dete rahinge bas ye sada
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Pyaase Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Keeje Rasheed is Gham ki hifazat
Ashk e Aza hain galb ki qawwat
Karte rahein har dam ye Ibadat
Maatam hai Shabbir ki Nusrat
Goonje faza me bas ye Sada
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Pyaase Hussain
author: Rasheed Shaheedi
